_note: Named watch themes for tv_scan_cli.py name-levels --theme and theme-slice. ids are input (bare or EXCHANGE:TICKER; the CLIs qualify them). industries are the GMV lens `ind` values a theme-slice reads. A theme is a list to look at, not a buy list.

ai_peers.label: AI infra, energy, construction and semis peers

ai_adopters.label: AI adopters: capex payers, software, platforms and services that gain when chips / data-center capacity get cheaper (not the build-out)

policy_midterm_up.label: Policy / midterm: sentiment helped by a Democratic Congress (clean energy kept from further cuts, grid, hospitals and ACA insurers, staples)

policy_midterm_down.label: Policy / midterm: sentiment hurt by a Democratic sweep (capital markets, aerospace and defense, crypto)

ai_power_build.label: AI power and data-center build: contractors, electrical gear, grid and the generators that sell to data centers (the crowd the 4 Nov 2026 Democratic sweep repriced on data-center construction limits). For calendar exposure maps.

solar_clean.label: Solar and clean-energy names that trade on federal credits and policy (the side the 4 Nov 2026 sweep lifted). For calendar exposure maps.

memory_storage.label: Memory and storage: the DRAM / NAND / disk cycle names. For calendar exposure maps.

discount_turn.label: Discounted to peers with fundamental strength and the tape turning up (catalyst book lane 2)

ai_upside_catalyst.label: AI names with large upside and a dated outside catalyst (catalyst book lane 3)
